FMTSysML:Behavioral_Requirement.text: While FPA mode is active,When FMCP issues an ALT hold Request,Then switch from FPA mode to ALT mode.
While FPA mode is active,If aircraft is on ground,When FMCP TOGA button is pressed,Then switch from FPA mode to TO mode.
While FPA mode is active,If aircraft is on air,When FMCP TOGA button is pressed,Then switch from FPA mode to GA mode.
While FPA mode is active,If height is greater than 400ft and VNAV mode is armed,When FMS issues VFLC request, Then switch from FPA mode to VFLC mode.
While FPA mode is active,If WS caution is active and height is less than 1500ft,When FMCP TOGA button is pressed, Then switch from FPA mode to WS mode.
While FPA mode is active,If WS caution is active and height is less than 1500ft,When TLA is in TOGA, Then switch from FPA mode to WS mode.
While FPA mode is active,If ASEL mode is armed,When ASEL height capture condition become met,Then switch from FPA mode to ASEL mode.
While FPA mode is active,When FMCP issues an VS Change Request,Then switch from FPA mode to VS mode.

FMTSysML:Constraint_Requirement.text: If the aircraft is on ground, AND both engines are NOT operating, AND the FMCP signal is valid, Or If the aircraft is on air,AND FD Available status is TRUE, AND the FMCP signal is valid, Then the AP Available status shall be set to TRUE.
If the minimum sensor configuration for AP/FD engagement is met, AND the FMCP signal is valid,Then the FD Available status shall be set to TRUE.

FMTSysML:Behavioral_Requirement.text: While AP Engage status is FALSE, If AP Available status is TRUE, When FMCP issues an AP Engagement Request, Then AP Engage status shall be set to TRUE.

FMTSysML:Constraint_Requirement.text: If FD Engage status is TRUE, AND AP Engage status is True, Then FD STDBY status shall be set to TRUE.

FMTSysML:Behavioral_Requirement.text: While AP Engage status is TRUE,When AP fast disconnection happens, Or FMCP issues AP Engage Request, Or WS mode status become TRUE, Or AFCS Alpha Floor Thrust activated, Or After the main landing gear load of 5s and the GA mode was not activated, OR The driver's foot hypercontrol is tilted from the flat position to > 10 degrees,Then the AP Engage status shall be set to FALSE.
While FD Engage status is FALSE, When any FD mode is connected, Then FD Engage status shall be set to TRUE.
While FPA mode is inactive,When AP become engaged with no vertical mode is active, Then FPA mode shall be set to active.
While FPA mode is inactive,If no vertical mode is active and no lateral mode is active except rolling mode,Then FPA mode shall be set to active.
While FPA mode is inactive,If FMCP height is not zero, And ASEL mode is active,Then FPA mode shall be set to active.

While FPA mode is inactive,If GS mode is active and Autoland mode is inactive and AP is Engaged,Or GS mode is active and Autoland mode is inactive and Roll mode is inactive,When FMCP APPR button was converted from disconnection to connection,Then FPA mode shall be set to active.
While FPA mode is inactive,If GS mode is active and AP is Engaged，When Loc mode become inactive,Then FPA mode shall be set to active.
While FPA mode is active,When FD become disengaged,Or any lateral mode was converted from active to inactive,Then switch from FPA mode to STDBY mode.
While FPA mode is active,If ROLL mode is active,When FMCP AP button was converted from connection to disconnection,Then switch from FPA mode to STDBY mode.
While ASEL mode is inactive and not armed,If VS/FLC/FPA/TO/GA mode is active,When FMCP ASEL knob set selected height,Then ASEL mode shall be set to armed.
While FPA mode is active,If GS mode is armed, When Glideslope capture conditions are met,Then switch from FPA mode to GS mode.

FMTSysML:Constraint_Requirement.text: If ASEL mode is armerd,Then the ASEL aimed height shall be set to equal to the selected height.

FMTSysML:Behavioral_Requirement.text: While FPA mode is active,When FMCP issues an FLC Request,Then switch from FPA mode to FLC mode.
While ASEL mode is armed,When the height capture condition become met, Then ASEL mode shall be set to active.
While FPA mode is active,If height is greater than 400ft and VNAV mode is armed,When FMS issues VALT request, Then switch from FPA mode to VALT mode.
While ASEL mode is active, When FMCP FD button was converted from connection to disconnection, Then ASEL mode shall be set to inactive and STDBY mode shall be set to active.
While FPA mode is active,If height is greater than 400ft and VNAV mode is armed,When FMS issues VPATH request, Then switch from FPA mode to VPATH mode.

While ALT mode is inactive,If TO/GA/ASEL/VS/FPA/FLC/VALT/VASEL/VPATH/VFLC/VFLS/STDBY mode is active, When FMCP issues an ALT hold Request (signal transition to TRUE),Then ALT mode shall be set to active.
While ASEL mode is armed,When the aircraft height become close to the aimed height,Then ALT mode shall be set to active.

FMTSysML:Constraint_Requirement.text: If ALT mode is active and is enteded by FMCP ALT knob,Then the ALT height shall be set to equal to ALT knob height.
If ALT mode is active and is enteded by ASEL mode,Then the ALT height shall be set to equal to ASEL aimed height.

FMTSysML:Behavioral_Requirement.text: While ALT mode is active, When FMCP FD button was converted from connection to disconnection, Then ALT mode shall be set to inactive and STDBY mode shall be set to active.

While VS mode is inactive,If TO/GA/ASEL/ALT/FPA/FLC/VALT/VASEL/VPATH/VFLC/VFLS/STDBY mode is active, When FMCP issues an VS Change Request (signal transition to TRUE),Then VS mode shall be set to active.
While VS mode is not active,If GS mode is active and Autoland mode is inactive，When FMCP issues an VS Change Request (signal transition to TRUE),Then VS mode shall be set to active.
While VS mode is not active,If WS mode is active and no caution alert and no warning alert，When FMCP issues an VS Change Request (signal transition to TRUE),Then VS mode shall be set to active.
While VS mode is active, When FMCP FD button was converted from connection to disconnection, Then VS mode shall be set to inactive and STDBY mode shall be set to active.
